- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Park Hyatt Tokyo is located in the heart of Shinjuku, one of Tokyo's most vibrant neighborhoods.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near Park Hyatt Tokyo include:
  - Nihonryori Ryugin (3-minute walk): A three-Michelin-starred restaurant serving innovative, modern Japanese cuisine.
  - Sushi Saito (5-minute walk): A three-Michelin-starred sushi restaurant focusing on traditional Edomae-style sushi.
  - Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei (10-minute walk): A high-end yakiniku restaurant with premium meats.
  - New York Grill (within Park Hyatt Tokyo): Offers classic American grill-style cuisine.
  - Girandole (within Park Hyatt Tokyo): A modern French restaurant focusing on seasonal ingredients.
  - Shunbou (5-minute walk): A contemporary French-Japanese fusion restaurant.
  - Tofuya Ukai (10-minute walk): A popular tofu restaurant with a serene atmosphere.
  - Toriki (10-minute walk): A yakitori restaurant with a lively atmosphere.
  - Ichiran Shinjuku (15-minute walk): A famous tonkotsu ramen chain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are highly recommended for popular restaurants, especially during peak travel seasons.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To get to Tsukiji Fish Market from Shinjuku using the Suica card:
  1. Take the JR Yamanote Line from Shinjuku Station towards Tokyo Station.
  2. Get off at Shimbashi Station.
  3. Transfer to the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line towards Asakusa.
  4. Get off at Tsukijishijo Station.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The total travel time from Shinjuku to Tsukiji Fish Market is around 30-40 minutes, and the fare is approximately ¥420-450 (around $4-5 USD).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended places to exchange money for yen near Park Hyatt Tokyo include:
  - Travelex (inside Shinjuku Station, 5-minute walk).
  - Seven Bank (inside Shinjuku Station, 5-minute walk).
  - Lawson Bank (5-minute walk from Park Hyatt Tokyo).
  - Tokyo Shinjuku Post Office (10-minute walk from Park Hyatt Tokyo).
